name: YourSMP
description:
Welcome to YourSMP.net — The Ultimate Crossplay SMP Experience!

Looking for a friendly, modern, and engaging Survival Multiplayer server? Whether you're a builder, trader, explorer, or RPG adventurer, YourSMP.net offers an enhanced vanilla-plus experience with a welcoming international community!

HIGHLIGHTS

- Java & Bedrock Crossplay — PC, Console, iOS, Android, Windows. No Java account needed for Bedrock.

- Custom World Generation with realistic biomes, custom trees and mountain ranges.

- RPG Progression (AuraSkills): Mining, Farming, Combat, Agility, Fishing with stat boosts and rewards.

- Proximity Voice Chat (Simple Voice Chat) with private groups.

- Easy Land Protection (GriefPrevention) with golden-shovel claims — no griefing!

- Player economy: chest shops, Auction House (/ah), server shop, night market.

- Bilingual (English & German) via /language.

- QoL: /sit /lay /crawl, dual horse riding, fishing tournaments, chat mini-games, /rtp.

HOW TO JOIN

Java: YourSMP.net, port 25565, 1.21.x (backward compatible to 1.9)

Bedrock: YourSMP.net, port 19132

Discord: https://discord.gg/QqKNue5yNH

Website: https://yoursmp.net

Join YourSMP.net today and start your next great Minecraft journey!
